capability: Audit an artifact against a claim with three independent reviewers and criterion-level convergence.

artifact.description: Path, diff, document, or inline text under review.

phase.description: Opaque file-name label; default review; never control.

evidence.description: Paths or excerpts for reviewers, including test output. Default [].

response.description: The skill's final answer, not a file. The per-round summary file has its own schema (call-contract.md, Round summary).

rules: The claim is decomposed into 3-7 checkable criteria; evidence adds inputs but never changes the claim; missing test output is reported as unverified execution.
converged: every blocking criterion converged (same verdict, confidence spread <= 0.2, no unanswered counterevidence); non-blocking disputes may remain and are listed.
unresolved: blocking disagreement remains after iteration 3; consensus is never forced.
error: the claim could not be decomposed, a reviewer file stayed malformed after regeneration by its owning reviewer, or the aggregator returned invalid_contract; nothing is converged.
overall_verdict is pass only if every blocking criterion converged on pass, fail if any converged on fail, else insufficient_evidence.
With require_reviewer_provenance, every reviewer file carries distinct reviewer_agent_id and reviewer_source; still missing after regeneration makes the status error.
not_converged is a per-round summary status, never a final status.
Gated callers advance only when scripts/validate_audit_transition.py advance_phase returns accepted; the gate commands in references/call-contract.md change only with this contract's version.
Each reviewer writes only its own file; in a Git repository the skill may add a repository-local exclude rule for audit_dir and never changes the index.

Callers never write or repair a reviewer file, never transcribe a reviewer's opinion, and never treat unresolved or error as a pass; they may tighten optional fields but not add required reviewer fields.
phase and caller_tag are opaque labels, never control.

changes.note: First contract. Phase default becomes the neutral label review; reviewer provenance is a caller-requested option owned by this skill; gate commands are part of the contract; frozen review bundles are removed (no caller used them).
Fold prose call-contract rules into rules; drop prose_contract. No behavior change.
